title: D, E, F
summary: Type the shifted symbols above the number row in labels, questions, and short records.
intro: Type the shifted symbols above the number row in labels, questions, and short records.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press d to type D. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: DffD DDDD DD fD DDfD DfDD ff DDD DDf

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press e to type E. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: EjE EEEE jjEE jEE EE EjjE jE EEE

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press f to type F. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: Fff fFfF FfF FffF FFF fF FF

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
screens.content: EEE EED FD jE EEEE EDDF DDF EE DE FFE DFE EDDE
